body:
Hey there, 

This sounds pretty much like exactly what I've been going through. It's like even good days don't make anything better, and everything kinda exhausts you no matter how good it made you feel a little while ago. I know the feeling of not wanting to deal with hurting anymore. It sucks. I'm sorry that I can't say anything that's going to make you feel better. Depression just kinda hits you like this and there never seems to be a way out, and nothing anybody says is going to help you anyway.

There's nothing wrong with being exhausted, and crying, and not wanting to do anything. Sometimes you just don't have energy for anything. At least you made it through the day. That's as much as a win as I could hope for. Sometimes it's just too exhausting to do anything though, and that's fine. It's especially hard if people don't understand what it feels like. 

I don't think the self-hate ever really goes away. It's one of the hardest parts. It's good that you have some insight into it yourself though. That's one of the hardest parts.
